title: HXR - XR, AI, Experiential Tech, Spatial Intelligence
description: HXR 2026: XR+ from Pixel to Voxel focuses on human-centered XR applications, aiming to empower the next generation of XR change-makers in today’s evolving industry. Our goal is to provide a platform for students, researchers, practitioners, and entrepreneurs to explore how XR is shaping the future across various industries. We will dive into the history, present, and future of XR, examining how emerging technologies can be leveraged and the challenges that lie ahead.

title: About 2026
headings: Founded in 2022, we are a group of grounded visionaries.

We are a non-profit organization based out of Harvard that hosts annual conferences and explores the boundaries of XR, AI, experiential tech, and spatial computing. Our goal is to provide a platform for students, researchers, practitioners, and entrepreneurs to discuss how digital realities are shaping the future across industries including entertainment, education, tech, and healthcare.

title: Showcase 2026
description: Organized by Harvard GSD XR club
headings: Hosted by the , the Showcase brings together experimental projects, research prototypes, speculative futures, and applied XR products in a curated, interdisciplinary environment. Harvard GSD XR Club

invites creators, researchers, designers, and founders from around the world to present cutting-edge work at the intersection of XR, AI, spatial computing, and embodied media. Under the 2026 theme , the showcase explores how immersive technologies are transforming design, perception, storytelling, and interaction—moving beyond screens toward fully embodied worlds.
